notes: Rates from USITC HTS 2026 Revision 20 (current release from 2026-09-28), REST search/exportList and Chapter 99 PDF. IEEPA headings 9903.01.20/.24 remain printed in Rev 20 but CBP ceased collection from 2026-02-24; Section 122 heading 9903.03.01 expired at close of 2026-07-23 per Chapter 99 compiler's note. Both are excluded.

stat_suffix_checked.conclusion: REST search lists 14 ten-digit statistical suffixes (04, 07, 11, 12, 14, 18, 23, 27, 37, 40, 45, 60, 65, 70); the 16.5% general rate and the Section 301 headings apply at the 8-digit level, with no suffix-specific rate.

exclusions_checked.conclusion: Not listed in U.S. note 20(vvv) or 20(www), the only Section 301 exclusion subdivisions in effect. No exclusion applies. Listed in the List 4A table of U.S. note 20(s).
exclusions_checked.basis: data/params/raw/ch99.json; Chapter 99 PDF text (U.S. note 20(vvv), 20(www), note 52); U.S. note 20 (Compiler's note): only subdivisions (vvv) and (www) are in effect; headings 9903.88.69 and 9903.88.70 run through 2026-11-09

stat_suffix_checked.conclusion: REST search lists suffixes 05, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 87, 89; a plastic phone case is expected under 3926.90.99.89 (Other); classification of the product itself not verified against CBP rulings.

exclusions_checked.conclusion: U.S. note 20(vvv)(iv)(4) excludes statistical numbers 3926.90.9915 and 3926.90.9920 (from 2026-07-01; 3926.90.9910 before) from List 4A under heading 9903.88.69, in effect through 2026-11-09 (not expired on 2026-10-09). 3926.90.9989 is excluded only for the specific medical products in U.S. note 20(vvv)(iv)(10)-(11) (sterile surgical drapes, sterile transfer containers), which do not include phone cases, so the 7.5% List 4A component applies to a phone case. U.S. note 52(d) lists 3926.90.99 only for civil aircraft parts.
exclusions_checked.basis: data/params/raw/ch99.json; Chapter 99 PDF text (U.S. note 20(vvv), 20(www), note 52); U.S. note 20 (Compiler's note): only subdivisions (vvv) and (www) are in effect; headings 9903.88.69 and 9903.88.70 run through 2026-11-09

4202.92.31.desc: Bags with outer surface of man-made fiber textile; tasks use suffix 31 (Other, e.g. travel bags), not 20 (Backpacks)

exclusions_checked.conclusion: U.S. note 20(vvv)(iii)(29) excludes 4202.92.3120 backpacks of man-made fiber textile, 35 to 75 cm high, 19 to 34 cm wide, 5 to 26 cm deep, from the List 3 duty under heading 9903.88.69, in effect through 2026-11-09 (not expired on 2026-10-09). The snapshot keeps the 25% List 3 component, which applies to backpacks outside these dimensions and to suffix 31; for a backpack within the dimensions the List 3 component is 0.
exclusions_checked.basis: data/params/raw/ch99.json; Chapter 99 PDF text (U.S. note 20(vvv), 20(www), note 52); U.S. note 20 (Compiler's note): only subdivisions (vvv) and (www) are in effect; headings 9903.88.69 and 9903.88.70 run through 2026-11-09

exclusions_checked.conclusion: Not listed in U.S. note 20(vvv) or 20(www). List 4B (heading 9903.88.16, U.S. note 20(t)-(u)) is suspended per the Compiler's note, so the 0 rate needs no exclusion.
